How ordering actually works

No cart. No checkout. Trade buying has its own rhythm — here's ours, step by step, the way it has run since 2000.

  1. 1

    Browse & shortlist

    Filter by brand, age and season. Check the cloth, the GSM, the pack — everything you'd feel with your hands, written down.

  2. 2

    Build your list

    Add packs as you go. Mix AMY and MY CHILD freely. Change quantities any time before you send — nothing is locked.

  3. 3

    We price it for you

    Send the list with your business details. We reply with the per-style trade price, what's in stock, and how soon it can leave Kolkata.

  4. 4

    Confirm & dispatch

    Agree quantities and terms on the quotation, and we pack and dispatch from Kolkata. Simple, documented, no surprises.

The cloth, and the man who still checks it

Proof, the way it actually happens here: twenty-five years of cotton, checked by hand, by people whose names are on the building.

Why 100% cotton, and what we tell parents

Newborn skin has no patience for synthetics, so AMY stays with cotton knits — interlock for gift sets, rib for basics, cambric for summer frocks. The GSM is printed on every style in the catalogue because a buyer should be able to feel the difference between 120 and 180 before the carton is opened. This is the care language printed on every swing tag, word for word:

  • Machine wash cold, gentle. Cotton softens with washing; hot water is what wears it out.
  • Dry in shade. Kolkata sun is strong enough for anyone's colours.
  • Warm iron if you must. Most knits come back smooth off the line.
  • No bleach, no soaking prints. The colours are set to stay; help them.

Questions buyers ask us first

Answered here, plainly, so you don't have to make a phone call to find out.

Why aren't prices shown on the catalogue?

Because a wholesale price depends on quantity, territory and season — a single printed price would mislead everyone. Add styles to your list and we'll quote the real trade rate for each one.

What is the minimum order?

It's set per style and printed on every card (in this prototype, 36 to 120 pieces per style). Mixed size ratios inside a style's pack are standard — that's how the packs are made.

Do you supply outside India?

Yes. We work with exporters and overseas buyers, with export-ready packing from Kolkata. Choose “Exporter” in the form and tell us the destination country in the notes.

What's the difference between AMY and MY CHILD?

AMY is infant essentials, 0–24 months — everyday cotton, sets, frocks, thermals and gift sets. MY CHILD is boys' party wear — coordinated dressed-up sets. Most of our retailers carry both.

Can I get the full catalogue as a PDF?

Yes — request the price list above, or message the sales desk on WhatsApp (+91 94777 60025) and ask for the current season line sheet for AMY, MY CHILD, or both.
